d: Short, spiky midnight-blue hair with a center part and sharp bangs frames a mature, adult face with narrow, focused midnight-blue eyes. The build is athletic and slender, dressed in a layered ensemble of white and navy blue plated armor over a dark underlayer, featuring a long white split-coat with gold trim and white leggings with brown leather straps. Accessories include navy blue gloves, a silver belt buckle, and a slender white staff tipped with a blue diamond gem.
